description: Compare a site audit against an earlier one: which issues are new, which were fixed, how many persist, and the health-score delta. Only pages BOTH crawls visited are compared, so a shorter crawl never reports the pages it missed as fixed — those are reported separately as notComparableCount. `newIssues` only ever covers an existing page newly showing a finding, never a brand-new page's own findings (those fold into notComparableCount/addedUrlCount instead, since a page neither crawl could compare has no meaningful 'new' vs. 'always there' answer). Returns an error when there is no earlier completed audit to compare against. Free — charges no credits.

auditId.description: Audit ID to compare, from crawl_site or get_crawl_results.

baselineAuditId.description: Audit ID to compare against. OMIT IT unless you have a reason: omitting picks the COMPLETED run immediately before auditId, while a baseline named here is used as given with no completed-status check — pointing it at a failed or still-running crawl diffs against a partial page set. Comparing an audit to itself is a validation error.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_audit_comparison
